turns.question: What should I cook tonight in Pretoria for two? I have about an hour and I shop at PnP. Give me the recipe and what it'll cost.
turns.answer:
Ek gee dit gou vir my kok; hy's nou-nou terug met 'n resep en 'n koste-skatting.My kok is terug, hier is wat hy gekry het:

![Maklike Kerrie Hoender Resep](https://idata.hiloved.com/imgs/71c8af47bc3e39b6-1024x681.jpg)

### The dish

Quick chicken curry with potatoes, carrots and onion, all cooked in one pan. It is ready in about 40 minutes, so it fits your hour, and it makes enough for two. It is a weeknight dish with cheap ingredients that you can buy at Pick n Pay in one trip.

### Recipe

Serves 2 · about 40 minutes

1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or deep pan on medium-high. Add the sliced onion and stir-fry until soft and glassy.
2. Add the curry paste and stir until fragrant. (If you use curry powder instead, add a little water to make a paste.)
3. Add the chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces, and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until browned and coated in the paste.
4. Add the carrots and potatoes and stir for 1 minute. Add the stock (a stock cube dissolved in 1 cup of hot water), the sugar, salt and pepper.
5. Cover and simmer on low for 15–20 minutes, until the chicken and potatoes are cooked through.
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Sprinkle with ground coriander if you like it. Serve hot.

Link: https://af.hiloved.com/maklike-kerrie-hoender-resep/
